Implementación idempotente

A deployment method where repeated execution of the process produces the same result, ensuring stability and preventing duplicate changes in integration environments.

Definition

A deployment method where repeated execution of the process produces the same result, ensuring stability and preventing duplicate changes in integration environments.

Operational example

Idempotent deployment scripts ensure that running the deployment multiple times will not result in unintended changes or errors.

Localized term

Implementación idempotente

Localized example

La implementación idempotente evita cambios indeseados si se ejecuta varias veces.
